templates.name: 1. Cotizar tarifa (responder a una solicitud del broker)
templates.description: Cuándo la usa Trucky: el broker pide capacidad/tarifa y Trucky ya calculó el número. Cotiza con el layout completo.
templates.subject: [Origin] -> [Delivery] - [Equipment] - Rate
templates.body:
Hi [Broker name],  
  
Thank you for reaching out. Please see our rate below:  
  
Pickup: [origin / port + terminal]  
Delivery: [delivery address]  
[Empty Return: [depot] - drayage only]  
[Equipment]: [size/type] - $[rate] All-In  
Includes: [LH + FSC + Chassis / LH + FSC]  
MC#: [MC]  
Availability: [Immediate / date]  
  
Before confirming, we wanted to clarify [operation / timing / accessorials]. Please confirm so we can proceed accordingly.  
  
Best regards,  
[Your name]  
[Company]  
MC# [MC] | DOT# [DOT]  
Phone: [phone]  
Email: [email]

templates.name: 2. ACEPTAR - 'We can make it work at $X All-In'
templates.description: Cuándo la usa Trucky: veredicto ACEPTAR: el usuario toma la carga y pide confirmación para cerrar.
templates.subject: [Origin] -> [Delivery] - Confirming
templates.body:
Hello [Broker name],  
  
Thank you for the update. We can make it work at $[rate] All-In.  
  
If possible, we would appreciate a confirmation today so we can get everything locked in and take it from there on our end.  
  
[Also, could you clarify [dispatch frequency / appointment / accessorial]?]  
  
Looking forward to hearing from you.  
  
Best regards,  
[Your name]  
[Company]  
MC# [MC] | DOT# [DOT]  
Phone: [phone]  
Email: [email]

templates.name: 3. NEGOCIAR - Contraoferta
templates.description: Cuándo la usa Trucky: veredicto NEGOCIAR: pedir un número por encima de lo ofrecido.
templates.subject: Re: [Origin] -> [Delivery]
templates.body:
Hi [Broker name],  
  
Thank you for the details. To make this one work on our end, our rate would be $[rate] All-In. We can commit today and keep you posted through delivery.  
  
Please let us know if that works and we'll get everything locked in.  
  
Best regards,  
[Your name]  
[Company]  
MC# [MC] | DOT# [DOT]  
Phone: [phone]  
Email: [email]

templates.name: 4. No se puede el timing - ofrecer alternativa y renegociar
templates.description: Cuándo la usa Trucky: no se puede cumplir la fecha/operación pedida; se ofrece alternativa y disposición a ajustar rate.
templates.subject: Re: [Origin] -> [Delivery]
templates.body:
Hi [Broker name],  
  
Unfortunately, [same-day delivery today / the requested timeline] is not possible on our end. We apologize for the inconvenience.  
  
[Please also note that [ports are closed Monday / constraint], so the earliest we could pick up and deliver would be [date].]  
  
That said, we understand this may not be the ideal timeline, and we are happy to negotiate the rate if that helps move forward.  
  
Please let us know how you'd like to proceed.  
  
Best regards,  
[Your name]  
[Company]  
MC# [MC] | DOT# [DOT]  
Phone: [phone]  
Email: [email]

templates.name: 5. RECHAZAR - pasar la carga (rate bajo el piso)
templates.description: Cuándo la usa Trucky: veredicto RECHAZAR: el rate no cubre; se declina dejando la puerta abierta.
templates.subject: Re: [Origin] -> [Delivery]
templates.body:
Hi [Broker name],  
  
Thank you for the offer on [lane]. Unfortunately, we can't make it work at $[offered] - our minimum on this run is $[floor] given [miles / deadhead / detention risk]. If anything opens up closer to that, please keep us in mind for future loads.  
  
Best regards,  
[Your name]  
[Company]  
MC# [MC] | DOT# [DOT]  
Phone: [phone]  
Email: [email]

templates.name: 6. Pedir información antes de cotizar
templates.description: Cuándo la usa Trucky: faltan datos para que Trucky calcule (commodity, citas, accesoriales, retorno).
templates.subject: [Origin] -> [Delivery] - a few details
templates.body:
Hi [Broker name],  
  
Thank you for reaching out. Before we send our rate, could you confirm:  
• Commodity & weight  
• Pickup & delivery appointment times  
• [Live load or drop / Empty return location - drayage]  
• Any accessorials (detention, layover[, per diem / chassis])  
• Your target All-In  
  
We'll get you our rate right back.  
  
Best regards,  
[Your name]  
[Company]  
MC# [MC] | DOT# [DOT]  
Phone: [phone]  
Email: [email]

templates.name: 7. Observaciones al Rate Confirmation (Verificador)
templates.description: Cuándo la usa Trucky: el Verificador marcó algo en el RC antes de firmar (detención, cláusula, fecha imposible).
templates.subject: Re: Rate confirmation - [load ref]
templates.body:
Hi [Broker name],  
  
Thank you for the rate confirmation. Before signing, we wanted to confirm a couple of items:  
• Detention terms: [X] hrs free, then $[Y]/hr  
• [TONU / delivery window / accessorial] isn't reflected  
  
Once we align on [item], we'll sign and send it right back.  
  
Best regards,  
[Your name]  
[Company]  
MC# [MC] | DOT# [DOT]  
Phone: [phone]  
Email: [email]

templates.name: 8. Seguimiento - pago / detención / POD
templates.description: Cuándo la usa Trucky: carga entregada: seguimiento a pago, detención o envío del POD.
templates.subject: [Load ref] - [POD / Detention / Invoice]
templates.body:
Hi [Broker name],  
  
Following up on [load ref], delivered [date]. [POD attached.] [Detention accrued [X] hrs at [location] on [date] = $[amount] per the rate confirmation.] Please advise on processing.  
  
Thank you,  
[Your name]  
[Company] · MC# [MC]

templates.name: Cotización - versión en español
templates.description: Cuándo la usa Trucky: mismo caso de cotizar tarifa, cuando el broker habla español.
templates.subject: [Origen] -> [Entrega] - [Equipo] - Tarifa
templates.body:
Hola [Broker],  
  
Gracias por escribirnos. Le compartimos nuestra tarifa:  
  
Recogida: [origen / puerto + terminal]  
Entrega: [dirección de entrega]  
[Devolución de vacío: [depot] - solo drayage]  
[Equipo]: [tamaño/tipo] - $[tarifa] All-In  
Incluye: [LH + FSC + Chasis / LH + FSC]  
MC#: [MC]  
Disponibilidad: [Inmediata / fecha]  
  
Antes de confirmar, quisiéramos aclarar [operación / tiempos]. Por favor confírmenos para proceder.  
  
Saludos cordiales,  
[Nombre] - [Empresa] · MC# [MC] | DOT# [DOT]  
Tel: [teléfono] · Email: [email]
